# Binbun Beam VFX — explicit free package

Original author: Binbun / Binbun3D
Official page: https://binbun3d.itch.io/beam-vfx
Public mirror: https://github.com/MeowLabPixel/Songkran-Hazard-4-Lom
Mirror source path: VFX_Water/BinbunVFXs/GodotBeamVFXFree/assets/BinbunVFX
License: CC0 1.0 Universal

The source path explicitly identifies this as `GodotBeamVFXFree`. Only that free package is imported. Godot-generated `.import` and `.uid` files are excluded. No paid preset pack is copied. Internal `res://` paths are rewritten to this staged library directory. This asset is not automatically connected to gameplay.
